scope: All applicable final development typed boundary errors; original ten clips only. No held-out material.
annotation_status: AI-assisted source-pair attribution; human review pending.
source_pair_policy: Each event has original source frames at event clip time minus1s and plus1s (clamped), plus an event-time source image for transition review. End requests clamp to duration minus0.1s to avoid seeking beyond the final encoded frame. Timestamps are requested clip times; decoding selects the corresponding source video frame. No extraction models run.
